```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(raster)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(funtimes)
library(data.table)
library(ggsci)

```

This takes the average winter ET and information about snow droughts and segments ET by snow drought type vs no snow drought

Plots time series of ET 

```{r time series of changes in ET fluxes by snow drought type over time}
classes <- c("Tundra",
             "Boreal Forest",
             "Maritime",
             "Ephemeral",
             "Prairie",
             "Montane Forest") #if looking at Ice, change here , "Ice")
names(classes) <- c("1","2","3","4","5","6") #if looking at ice, change here ,"7"

files <- list.files("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/TerraClim/7_aet_snow_drought/northern_boundaries/", full.names = TRUE) #change here for northern or southern

outs <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 64*24, ncol = 4))
names(outs) <- c("SnowClass","Drought","ET")
count = 1

for (file in files) {
  
  tmp <- read.csv(file) %>% filter(y > 0) ##SELECT HERE FOR HEMISPHERE
  names(tmp) <- c("X","x","y","Drought","ET","SnowClass")
  tmp2 <- tmp %>% select(Drought,ET,SnowClass) %>% filter(SnowClass != 7) #7 is ice
  year <- strsplit(strsplit(file,"/")[[1]][7],".csv")[[1]][1]
  
  tmp2$Drought <- as.factor(tmp2$Drought)
  levels(tmp2$Drought) <- list(Dry  = "1", Warm = "3", WarmDry = "4", NoDrought = "2")
  
  tmp3 <- tmp2 %>% group_by(SnowClass,Drought) %>% summarize_all(mean,na.rm=TRUE) %>% as.data.frame()
  tmp3$Year <- year
  
  outs[count:(count+nrow(tmp3)-1),1:4] <- tmp3
  count = count + nrow(tmp3)
  
}

write.csv(outs, "D:/NASA/SBG Drought/average_yearly_northern_boundaries_removed_et.csv")

```

```{r plotting time series}
##because i changed it to a factor above, the order of the snow droughts goes from normal to being 1 = Dry, 2 = Warm, 3 = WarmDry and 4 = NoDrought

avg <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/average_yearly_northern_boundaries_removed_et.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-X)
names(avg)[4] <- "Year"

avg <- avg[which(is.na(avg$SnowClass) == FALSE),]

```

```{r grabbing slopes of lm}

fitted_models = avg %>% group_by(SnowClass, Drought) %>% do(model = lm(ET~Year, data = .))
out <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=24,ncol=3))
names(out) <- c("SnowClass","Drought","Slope")

for (row in 1:nrow(fitted_models)){
  
  tmp <- fitted_models[row,1:3]
  tmp$Slope <- coef(tmp[[3]][[1]])[2]
  final <- tmp %>% dplyr::select(SnowClass,Drought,Slope) %>% as.data.frame()
  names(final) <- NULL
  out[row,1:3] <- final

}

out$Drought <- as.factor(out$Drought)
levels(out$Drought) <- list(Dry  = "1", Warm = "2", `Warm-Dry` = "3", NoDrought = "4")

out$SnowClass <- as.factor(out$SnowClass)
levels(out$SnowClass) <- list(Tundra = "1", `Boreal\nForest` = "2", Maritime = "3", `Ephemeral` ="4", Prairie = "5", `Montane\nForest` = "6") 

```

THIS SHOWED THAT THE TRENDS ARE ROBUST TO STANDARDIZATION
```{r standardizing to test if the trend is robust}
out <- data.frame(matrix(ncol=4,nrow=64*24))
count = 1

for (class in unique(avg$SnowClass)) {
  tmp1 <- avg %>% filter(SnowClass == class)
  
  for (snow in unique(avg$Drought)){
    
    tmp2 <- tmp1 %>% filter(Drought == snow) %>% select(ET)
    scl <- data.frame(scale(tmp2$ET))
    years <- tmp1 %>% filter(Drought == snow) %>% select(Year)
    scl$Year <- years$Year
    scl$SnowClass <- class
    scl$Drought <- snow
    
    out[count:(count+nrow(scl)-1),1:4] <- scl
    
    count = count + nrow(scl)
  }
}

names(out) <- c("ET","Year","SnowClass","Drought")
out <- out[1:1532,]
```

testing for linear or any trend
```{r testing for trends in average yearly time series}
out2 <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=24,ncol=6))
names(out2) <- c("SnowClass","Drought","Linear_P","MK_P","Linear_Sig","MK_Sig")
count = 1

for (snow in unique(avg$SnowClass)) { #CHANGE HERE FOR WHICH DATASET
  tmp <- avg %>% filter(SnowClass == snow) #CHANGE HERE FOR WHICH DATASET
  
  for (drought in unique(avg$Drought)) { #CHANGE HERE FOR WHICH DATASET
    
    tmp2 <- tmp %>% filter(Drought == drought)
    p_val1 <- notrend_test(tmp2$ET)$p.value #linear trend test
    p_val2 <- notrend_test(tmp2$ET, test = "MK")$p.value #mann kendall test
        
    out2[count,1] <- snow
    out2[count,2] <- drought
    out2[count,"Linear_P"] <- p_val1
    out2[count,"MK_P"] <- p_val2
    count = count + 1
    
  }
  
  
}

out2[,c(5:6)] <- "No Sig"
out2[which(out2$Linear_P < 0.05),"Linear_Sig"] <- "Sig"
out2[which(out2$MK_P < 0.05),"MK_Sig"] <- "Sig"

out2$SnowClass <- as.factor(out2$SnowClass)
levels(out2$SnowClass) <- list(Tundra = "1", `Boreal Forest` = "2", Maritime = "3", `Ephemeral` ="4", Prairie = "5", `Montane Forest` = "6") 

out2$Drought <- factor(out2$Drought, levels=c('Dry', 'Warm', 'Warm-Dry', 'NoDrought'))


```

```{r creating a difference from no drought plot}
# avg$Drought <- as.factor(avg$Drought)
# levels(avg$Drought) <- list(Dry  = "1", Warm = "2", WarmDry = "3", NoDrought = "4")
# 
avg$SnowClass <- as.factor(avg$SnowClass)
levels(avg$SnowClass) <- list(Tundra = "1", `Boreal Forest` = "2", Maritime = "3", `Ephemeral` ="4", Prairie = "5", `Montane Forest` = "6")
avg$ID <- paste(avg$SnowClass,avg$Drought,sep="-")

nodrought <- avg %>% filter(Drought=="NoDrought")
drought <- avg %>% filter(Drought != "NoDrought")

dif <- merge(nodrought,drought, by = c("Year","SnowClass"))
dif <- dif %>% dplyr::select(Year,SnowClass,ET.x,Drought.y,ET.y,ID.y)
names(dif) <- c("Year","SnowClass","ET_no","Drought","ET_drought","ID")                                     
dif$dif <- dif$ET_drought - dif$ET_no

dif2 <- merge(dif,out2,by = c("SnowClass","Drought"))


ts_plot_dif <- ggplot(dif2,aes(x = Year, y = dif, color = as.factor(SnowClass),linetype = Linear_Sig)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  labs(y = "ET Difference from No Drought (mm)",color="",linetype="")+
  facet_wrap(.~Drought,ncol=3,nrow=1,scales="free") +
  scale_color_npg(labels = classes)+
  stat_smooth(method = "lm",se=FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dashed","solid"))+
  guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=3))+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(color = "NA"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size=12)
        )+
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black")))
  


png("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/et_diff_time_series.png", width = 7, height = 3.8,units = "in", res=800)
print(ts_plot_dif)
dev.off()

```
